name: Tier 4: Real-World Application Scenarios Suite
description: Comprehensive real-world end-to-end scenarios covering complete lifecycle execution from Phase 0 Discovery to Phase N Closing across all 3 sizing tiers.

scenarios.name: Production Hotfix in Brownfield Monorepo (CTA Button Hover Token Fix)
scenarios.context: A live production website exhibits broken hover styles on CTA buttons in /contacto due to an un-synced design token.

actions: Inspect workspace configuration: confirms Astro + Tailwind monorepo with pnpm
Verify baseline test and build command: `pnpm build` succeeds
Identify target file: `src/styles/tokens.css` (approx line 42)
Evaluate sizing questionnaire: 1 file affected, 6 lines changed, 0 schema changes, 0 public contract changes
Deterministic classification: Tier 1 (Small / Hotfix)
Draft `specs/hotfixes/20261029-button-hover.md` using `specs/_template_hotfix.md`
Micro-spec contains: Problem (1 sentence), Affected Files (1 file), Solution (token fix), Verification (pnpm build + visual check)
Total spec length: 21 lines (<25 line limit)
Apply minimal CSS token update in `src/styles/tokens.css`
Execute verification command: `pnpm build` passes with zero warnings
Confirm visual hover state meets Acceptance Criteria
Complete abbreviated PVS sign-off in micro-spec
Mark micro-spec as COMPLETADA
Update `Engram.md` with 1-line entry in ## 4. Estado de Módulos
Create standardized commit: `fix(ui): correct cta button hover token in tokens.css`

verification_criteria: Spec length <= 25 lines
Total modified files == 1
Net changed LOC <= 10
Engram.md updated and remains < 150 lines
Zero token waste (<3,000 tokens total)

scenarios.name: Greenfield Full-Stack Feature (User Profile View & REST Endpoint)
scenarios.context: A greenfield enterprise portal requires a new User Profile page and backend endpoint to query preferences.

actions: Map directory topography: confirms Feature-Sliced Design in `src/features/` and Axum backend in `src/api/`
Audit verification commands: `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`
Evaluate questionnaire: 6 files affected, ~180 LOC, additive schema changes, confined to user module
Deterministic classification: Tier 2 (Medium / Standard SDD)
Draft `specs/004-user-profile.md` using `specs/_template.md`
Define Gherkin Acceptance Criteria (AC-01 successful profile fetch, AC-02 missing token 401)
Model technical interfaces: UserProfileDto, ProfileView.tsx component, GET /api/user/profile route
Specify task breakdown: Task 1 types, Task 2 endpoint handler, Task 3 UI view, Task 4 unit tests
Orchestrator dispatches Worker with scoped Result Contract (<300 word message)
Worker implements types in `src/features/user/types.ts`
Worker implements endpoint in `src/api/user.rs` (or .ts)
Worker implements UI view in `src/features/user/ProfileView.tsx` adhering to design tokens
Worker authors unit test suite and runs `pnpm test` -> passes on Attempt 1
Reviewer checks PR diff: 182 lines changed (<300 LOC limit)
Reviewer verifies no out-of-scope files were touched
Reviewer checks type safety (no `any` types) and ponytail simplicity
Execute Post-Implementation Verification Sign-Off (PVS) with test logs
Update `Engram.md`: add technical decision entry and set User Profile module to Stable
Mark `specs/004-user-profile.md` as COMPLETADA
Generate Keep a Changelog entry under `Added:`

verification_criteria: Orchestrator never writes code in src/
80/20 token budget maintained: >=80% volume executed on Tier 2 models
PR net lines <= 300 LOC
PVS table completely filled with passing test evidence
Spec status marked COMPLETADA with timestamp

scenarios.name: Architectural Migration Epic (Database Adapter Replacement)
scenarios.context: Replacing a deprecated embedded database engine with PostgreSQL across 14 repository services.

actions: Execute full 6-pillar repository audit
Document existing database query interfaces, connection pools, and invariants in `ARCH_AUDIT.md`
Verify pre-existing baseline test state
Evaluate questionnaire: 14 files affected, >400 LOC, database schema migration, core architecture impact
Deterministic classification: Tier 3 (Large / Epic)
Draft `specs/005-postgres-migration.md` using `specs/_template_epic.md`
Decompose into 3 decoupled Tier 2 milestone slices: M1 Connection & Schemas (<250 LOC), M2 Repositories (<280 LOC), M3 Integration Tests & Rollback (<200 LOC)
Challenger stress-tests connection pooling limits, connection leaks, and rollback idempotency
Challenger signs Adversarial Review Gate approving architecture
Worker 1 implements Slice M1; unit tests pass; Reviewer approves
Worker 2 implements Slice M2; unit tests pass; Reviewer approves
Worker 3 implements Slice M3; integration tests pass; Reviewer approves
Forensic Auditor audits full git diff against main branch
Verifies zero loosened assertions in existing test suites
Verifies zero unauthorized external dependencies in lockfile
Signs Forensic Integrity Certificate
Comprehensive E2E verification sign-off
Author Architectural Decision Record in `docs/ADR_005_postgres.md`
Prune and synchronize `Engram.md`: consolidated to 125 lines (budget 80-150)
Generate Keep a Changelog section with Changed and Security notes

verification_criteria: Code implementation strictly blocked until Adversarial Review Gate signed
All slices form a DAG with <300 LOC each
Forensic Auditor retains absolute binary veto authority
Verified rollback strategy documented in Section 5 of Epic spec
Engram.md strictly between 80 and 150 lines upon completion

scenarios.name: Worker Circuit Breaker Escalation during Legacy Integration
scenarios.context: Worker integrating a legacy payment gateway encounters recurring cryptographic signature verification failures.

actions: Worker drafts signature verification logic under approved spec
Worker executes local test: fails with SignatureVerificationError (Attempt 1 triggered)
Worker analyzes error log: hypothesizes UTF-8 encoding issue and applies patch
Worker re-tests: fails with MalformedPayloadException (Attempt 2 triggered)
Worker fails Attempt 2: 2-Attempt Circuit Breaker trips immediately
Worker is legally forbidden from attempting Attempt 3
Worker halts code mutations immediately
Worker writes verbatim error output and git diff to `.agents/teamwork/worker/escalation.md`
Worker sends concise coordination message (<300 words) with escalation file path to Orchestrator
Orchestrator (Tier 1 Pro model) analyzes SDK documentation and byte-order endianness rules
Orchestrator identifies root architectural issue: legacy gateway requires big-endian packing
Orchestrator delivers revised Result Contract with endianness specification
Worker restarts with fresh circuit breaker state (0 attempts)
Worker applies endianness fix; test passes on first run
Worker proceeds to standard closing

verification_criteria: Worker never executes Attempt 3
Zero infinite retry loops; token exhaustion prevented
Escalation file contains verbatim compiler error and file diff
Coordination message strictly < 300 words

scenarios.name: Adversarial Red-Team & Forensic Integrity Audit Veto
scenarios.context: Worker under time pressure attempts to bypass a flaky edge-case test by commenting out an assertion before merging.

actions: Worker encounters intermittent failure in `test_token_expiry`
Worker changes `assert expiry > now` to `assert True` to force green test run
Reviewer inspects code style, imports, and PR description
Reviewer overlooks subtle one-line test assertion modification and issues tentative approval
Challenger probes token expiration logic for edge cases
Challenger hypothesizes security vulnerability: expired tokens remain accepted if system clock skews
Challenger flags threat in Adversarial Threat Report
Forensic Auditor compares git diff against `main` for all test files in `tests/`
Auditor detects tampered assertion in `tests/auth.test.ts` line 84
Auditor triggers BINARY VETO: issues **INTEGRITY VIOLATION VETO REPORT**
Merge is unconditionally blocked; Orchestrator alerted
Tampered commit is reverted
Worker fixes underlying clock skew handling using NTP mock
Original test assertion restored and verified passing
Forensic Auditor conducts re-audit and issues Signed Integrity Certificate

verification_criteria: Forensic Auditor veto unconditionally blocks merge
Test suite assertion loosening detected and rejected
Adversarial Challenger identifies unhandled edge-case vulnerability
Zero compromised code merged to main
